strings.notes: US 0671/0; 英字 = 0719 #41/#303 Eddie (US contact Bird Keeper Jose)

strings.zh: 哔！哔！{SCROLL}说起这只大葱鸭,{NEWLINE}只要它看到漂亮的东西,{CLEAR}不管是什么都会叼起来⋯⋯{SCROLL}你喜欢漂亮的东西吗？{SCROLL}下次我再拿到的话,{NEWLINE}就分给你一点吧！{SCROLL}我们交换一下{NEWLINE}电话号码吧,{CLEAR}这样我这边一旦有什么东西{CLEAR}就能直接联系上你了。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Tweet! Tweeeeeet!{SCROLL}If my Farfetch’d sees anything pretty,{NEWLINE}it goes and gets it.{SCROLL}Do you like pretty things?{NEWLINE}I could share if it gets some more.{SCROLL}How about we trade phone numbers?{NEWLINE}I’ll call if it finds anything. {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 我得到漂亮的东西后{NEWLINE}会打电话联系你的！
strings.en: I’ll call you as soon as I get{NEWLINE}something pretty.

strings.zh: 是吗？{NEWLINE}要是你改变注意的话,{CLEAR}随时都可以来找我！
strings.en: You sure? Well, tell me if you change{NEWLINE}your mind.

strings.zh: 哔！哔！{SCROLL}你喜欢漂亮的东西吗？{NEWLINE}等大葱鸭下次叼到什么东西后{CLEAR}就分给你一点吧！{SCROLL}所以请把你的电话号码给我吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Tweet! Tweeeeeet!{NEWLINE}Do you like pretty things?{SCROLL}I could share if Farfetch’d goes{NEWLINE}and gets more.{SCROLL}Will you give me your{NEWLINE}phone number? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哔！哔！{SCROLL}爱？{SCROLL}⋯⋯啊,是吗。{NEWLINE}我还以为你是被{CLEAR}我的笛声所吸引来的！{SCROLL}原来你是来拿{NEWLINE}星之碎片的啊。{SCROLL}给你吧,哔！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Tweet! Tweeeeeet! Huh? ...Oh, I see.{SCROLL}I thought you came over here because{NEWLINE}you were enticed by my whistling.{SCROLL}So you came for the Star Piece. Here{NEWLINE}you go! Tweet!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0671/5 | RV072: omission: restored final 哔

strings.zh: 哔！哔！{SCROLL}⋯⋯哎？{NEWLINE}难道你就在附近？{SCROLL}那你就{NEWLINE}直接和我说话好了嘛！
strings.en: Tweet! Tweeeeeet!{SCROLL}...Huh? Wait, don’t tell me that you’re{NEWLINE}calling from nearby?{SCROLL}Well, why not come a little closer and{NEWLINE}talk in person!

strings.zh: 听我说！{NEWLINE}我的{VAR:0100:10}的大葱{CLEAR}味道实在太好闻了。{SCROLL}一闻到这股味道,{NEWLINE}我肚子就开始饿了！{SCROLL}下次再聊吧！
strings.en: Listen! My {VAR:0100:10}’s{NEWLINE}leek smells so good.{SCROLL}One whiff and my stomach{NEWLINE}starts growling!{SCROLL}Talk to you later!

strings.zh: 前几天大葱鸭{NEWLINE}打倒了{VAR:0100:11}⋯⋯{SCROLL}真想让你也来看看{NEWLINE}当时大葱鸭的大葱舞啊！{SCROLL}下次再聊！
strings.en: The other day, my Farfetch’d{NEWLINE}beat a {VAR:0100:11}...{SCROLL}I wish you could’ve seen its leek dance!{SCROLL}Talk to you later!

strings.zh: 这几天我见到了{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}⋯⋯{SCROLL}比我想象中的速度还要快,{NEWLINE}刚想要抓它的时候,{CLEAR}就被它一溜烟逃掉了。{CLEAR}真是好可惜啊。{SCROLL}下次再聊吧！
strings.en: I ran into a wild {VAR:0100:11}...{SCROLL}I was trying to catch it, but it took{NEWLINE}off faster than I thought it would.{CLEAR}It was a bit disappointing.{SCROLL}Be seeing you!

strings.zh: 我们再来一次对战吧？{NEWLINE}我的大葱鸭现在{CLEAR}可是斗志满满啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}你路过的话就和我打个招呼吧！
strings.en: Want to battle again? My Farfetch’d is{NEWLINE}all fired up right now...{SCROLL}I’m on {VAR:0104:3}. If you’re{NEWLINE}passing by, come say hi!
strings.notes: US 0671/10; modernised from US 0671#10 | RV072: meaning: 'if you're passing by, say hi'; removed 'for some reason'

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}你能不能来快点？{SCROLL}大葱鸭都等不及了⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你要是来太晚的话,{CLEAR}我就要被大葱抽打啦！{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:3}所以！{NEWLINE}你快点来吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}! Could you hurry over?{SCROLL}Farfetch’d can’t wait any{NEWLINE}longer... If you’re too late,{CLEAR}I’ll get whacked with its leek!{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:3}! So please hurry!

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}! Could you hurry over?{SCROLL}Farfetch’d can’t wait any{NEWLINE}longer... If you’re too late,{CLEAR}I’ll get whacked with its leek!{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:3}! So please hurry!

strings.zh: 我现在还没有{NEWLINE}之前说好的东西,{SCROLL}一旦得到了我会联系你的,{NEWLINE}所以请你再等等吧。
strings.en: I haven’t gotten what I promised{NEWLINE}you yet.{SCROLL}I’ll call you as soon as I get it, so{NEWLINE}could you wait a little longer?

strings.zh: 我的大葱鸭{NEWLINE}把漂亮的东西叼回来了。{SCROLL}既然跟你说好了,就给你吧。{SCROLL}我们在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}方便的话来一下吧。
strings.en: My Farfetch’d had something pretty in{NEWLINE}its beak.{SCROLL}Like I promised, you can have it.{SCROLL}Catch up to me on {VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}and I’ll let you have it.

strings.zh: 怎么？不要吗？　{NEWLINE}我们在{VAR:0104:3},{CLEAR}快点来吧。
strings.en: What’s wrong? Don’t you want it? We’re{NEWLINE}on {VAR:0104:3}, so hurry over.
